ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jul-10-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Arlene Howell.
Petitioner: Mei Wan Lau, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Shing K. Lau aka Shing Kit Lau, and with Cantonese Interpreter: Jenny Yau.
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
No appearance by the Co-Petitioner/Minor's Father: Tonny Lau, but signed the Petition consenting to the name change of the minor.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Ethan Shing Kit Lau.
Decree signed in open court.

HEARING ORDERED FOR APPLICATION OF WAIVER OF COURT FEES
Off Calendar May-30-2007 Denied
